scope: Exact private Foundation runtime packages and complete private Host payload qualified by F6; public tools, analyzer and OCI pins remain at the established stable profile.

compatibility.identityAdmission: Exactly one authenticated identity and one nonempty validated issuer/subject pair; projection claims survive native claim actions.
compatibility.problemEnvelope: correlationId with traceId compatibility alias; domain mappings contribute through the native shared representation.
compatibility.canonicalBytes: Existing canonical-v1 schema order, normalization, bytes, hashes and replay identities remain application-owned and unchanged.
compatibility.persistence: Provider-owned native contexts use independent nonpooled factories inside tracked shell leases; cancellation does not establish rollback or commit certainty.
compatibility.json: Typed strict request and bounded success/problem profiles; server output failures remain safe server failures before success commitment.
